answer: The stake is a hostage, not a fee: 25 POA per identity, released only after 14 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 715 fakes must lock 17875 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The voyage of the hostage is the deterrent, the kernel of the slow release is the filter, and the comet of the burn is the punishment.
